plants.author: Farid Haddad
plants.text: Another cancellation alert went out for the 07:30 after it had already sailed this morning, so SYN-54 isn't fixed. Passengers are confused.

plants.author: Amara Okafor
plants.text: The status page from SYN-85 is live; the link is in the channel topic for anyone who asks. Nice work all.

about: Chat says a done fix isn't fixed; chat announces another is live.
